title: The Penalty — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 100bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal English Spanish French language learning trilingual football
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
Twelve yards
One man with the ball
One man with no instructions except to stop it
And eighty thousand people who have already decided

[Verse 2 — Español]
El portero se lanza antes del disparo [The goalkeeper dives before the kick]
El ochenta por ciento del tiempo adivina mal [Eighty percent of the time he guesses wrong]
El lanzador lo sabe [The kicker knows this]
El portero sabe que el lanzador lo sabe [The goalkeeper knows the kicker knows this]
La multitud no sabe nada de esto [The crowd knows none of this]
Y grita de todas formas [And screams anyway]

[Chorus — English]
The penalty is the loneliest moment in football
One decision, one direction
And the moment it leaves the boot
Nothing can bring it back — not even regret

[Bridge — Français]
Chas disait — le penalty te dit tout sur quelqu'un [Chas said — the penalty tells you everything about a person]
Pas qui ils sont quand ils marquent [Not who they are when they score]
Qui ils sont quand ils s'avancent en sachant qu'ils pourraient ne pas marquer [Who they are when they step up knowing they might not]
C'est le test [That's the test]
Douze yards est une très longue marche quand le monde entier regarde [Twelve yards is a very long walk when the whole world is watching]

[Verse 3 — English]
The keeper already knows where it's going
The kicker just hasn't told himself yet

[Outro — EN/ES/FR]
The penalty
El penalti [The penalty]
Le penalty [The penalty]
That's my boy
